definition: Deep Instinct is a cybersecurity company that applies deep learning to cybersecurity.
details: The company implements artificial intelligence to the task of preventing and detecting malware. The company was the recipient of the Technology Pioneer by The World Economic Forum in 2017. Lane Bess has been CEO of the company since 2022.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. In plain words: Deep Instinct is a cybersecurity company that applies deep learning to cybersecurity. Here is how it actually plays out: The company implements artificial intelligence to the task of preventing and detecting malware. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is Deep Instinct.
